nodes.label: Buffer-Then-Chunk SSE Streaming
nodes.rationale: Chosen over live token-by-token ChatClient.stream() so the output guardrail can run before the client sees any text; cost is that it is not 'real' streaming.

nodes.label: JPA-to-R2DBC Migration
nodes.rationale: Only user/* and ChatService.validateParticipantIds were migrated because Postgres is the one store with a reactive driver; a blocking JDBC DataSource is kept solely for Flyway migrations.

nodes.label: Thin-Alias Root Makefile
nodes.rationale: Every recipe shells out to gradlew/npm/docker/node so Gradle stays the source of truth; goal was discoverability of commands split across module scopes and differing docker build contexts, not new build capability. Written for macOS GNU make 3.81.

nodes.label: Semantic cache as read-caching for scale
nodes.rationale: SemanticCacheService caches guardrail-validated answers in a second Qdrant collection instead of Cassandra/Redis, matched by semantic similarity of the normalized query

nodes.norm_label: kubernetes deploy layer (kubeadm on ec2) (wiki doc)

nodes.label: Cluster bootstrap seed election (SSM lock)
nodes.rationale: Control-plane/worker user-data race on an SSM parameter without --overwrite to elect a kubeadm-init winner without a designated node; staging (1 CP) skips the lock

nodes.label: CI -> cluster via SSM Run Command
nodes.rationale: No internet-facing API NLB and no self-hosted runner; a custom aws_ssm_document runs kubectl apply on a tagged control-plane node with no inbound 6443 exposure
nodes.norm_label: ci -> cluster via ssm run command

nodes.label: RAG as a single source of truth
nodes.rationale: The same support_kb Qdrant collection answers both the scope filter/whitelist and the retrieved knowledge_snippet
nodes.norm_label: rag as a single source of truth

nodes.label: Reactive end-to-end (Bedrock/Qdrant bridged)
nodes.rationale: WebFlux Mono/Flux throughout; Bedrock/Qdrant calls bridged via Schedulers.boundedElastic() since neither has a reactive-native client

nodes.label: Roadmap note: compute pivot to Kubernetes
nodes.rationale: Phase 3b deploy target changed from ECS Fargate to self-managed kubeadm-on-EC2; ecs-service/alb/bedrock-iam retained lint-clean but unused
nodes.norm_label: roadmap note: compute pivot to kubernetes

nodes.label: Container env-var contract
nodes.rationale: Every plaintext_env / container_env key must line up across application-{staging,prod}.properties and the demo-chat-config ConfigMap; secrets flow via Secrets Manager and the deploy workflow instead

nodes.label: Known gaps / TODO list
